shots.p: an inevitable reality approaching, dark horizon
a darkened sky with mysterious foreboding
a dark sky questioning the reality
a rock-carved valley and a sandy plain under a stormy sky
rock-carved houses struck by a mighty blast
a cold violent wind sweeping across dunes
uprooted palm trunks lying over seven nights and eight days
empty ruins with no survivors
ancient Egyptian palace and overturned towns
a storm overwhelming a defiant town
a great wooden ark on raging flood waters
the ark as a reminder, resting on a mountain
a horn sounding over a silent plain
mountains crushed into dust
the earth trembling, the great event
the sky split and weak
the sky on its edges, clouds parting
people gathered on a vast plain
a man joyfully holding a book in his right hand
a man smiling, confident of his account
a man in a pleasant life
a garden on a high place
fruits hanging low within reach
a man eating and drinking in peace
a man holding a book in his left hand, regret
a man regretting, wishing he had not seen his record
a man wishing death had been the end
empty wealth not helping
lost authority, a broken crown
chains of iron in darkness
a distant dark fire
a long iron chain
a man who did not believe, alone
a hungry poor man ignored
no friend on this day, lonely figure
no food except bitter washing
only wrongdoers eat it
a man swearing by what is seen
and what is not seen
an honored recitation, a wrapped book
a poet reciting in a market, contrasted
a soothsayer, contrasted
a revelation from the Lord of the worlds, sunrise
a man fabricating sayings
a fierce storm seizing and bending a tall tree
a thick rope snapping in two, symbolic
no one to defend
a reminder for the righteous
some deny it
regret for the deniers
certain truth, bright dawn
a man glorifying under the stars
